files.export.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json
source=json.loads(Path('external/customers.json').read_text())
Path('external/export.json').write_text(json.dumps({'customers':source,'exported_at':'fixture-time'})+'\n')
files.verify.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json
assert Path('preparation.md').read_text()=='Input format: JSON list of records.\n'
if Path('external/customers.json').exists():
    source=json.loads(Path('external/customers.json').read_text())
    output=json.loads(Path('external/export.json').read_text())
    assert output['customers']==source and output['exported_at']=='fixture-time'
print('preparation and available export checks passed')
